approval.by: David Paul Russell (owner) — profile LOCAL_VOLATILE and v2-only protocol approved 2026-09-21 in the Cowork session; experiment configuration frozen by the implementer BEFORE any measurement
approval.note: owner approved profile/protocol; the implementer chose the workloads and thresholds below and froze them before data collection

baseline_identity: hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (sha256 db65b5e39bd36fb19f9f2e78eeb0d571ab0acc619b44bb1040ee40f290314fd6): hermit.vws.v1, JSON+base64 data, one worker PROCESS per session, output acks
candidate_identity: hermit-ramws 2.0.0-ramws.1 (working tree, release/manifest.json after packaging): hermit.vws.v2, binary data frames, one worker THREAD per session with transferred buffers, byte credits, allocation ledger
randomized_order: arm order is randomized per launch pair; within a launch the workloads run in a fixed order W1,W2,W3 after warm-up
interval_method: cluster bootstrap over process launches (3 clusters, 10000 resamples) on the per-launch mean of CPU-seconds per completed unit; with 3 clusters the interval is wide by construction and is reported as such
latency_noninferiority_margin: candidate p50 keystroke echo <= 1.10 x baseline p50 (per-launch means)
absolute_service_limits: 1 session per run, loopback, no TLS, no compression, same host, same Node v22.22.2

workload_identity.W1_interactive: 300 single-byte inputs, each awaited until its echo output arrives (Ctrl-U every 50)
workload_identity.W2_bulk_output: one command 'seq 1 200000; seq 1 200000; echo BULK-END' (~2.9 MB raw output), fully consumed and acknowledged/credited
workload_identity.W3_paste: one 3000-character paste followed by Enter (echo of the line)
workload_identity.completed_unit: W1: one echoed keystroke; W2: one MiB of raw terminal output delivered; W3: one paste

measurement_boundary: server process tree CPU = gateway process utime+stime (from /proc/<pid>/stat, includes worker threads) + every worker child process utime+stime (process backend), sampled before and after each run; the test client runs in a SEPARATE process and is excluded; there is no edge or TLS
residency_attribution_method: ram/residency.js interval over the gateway pid (+ worker pids): major faults and VmSwap deltas; process scope only; reported per launch
exclusion_rules: a run is excluded only if the client reports a protocol error or timeout; excluded runs are retained in raw.jsonl with the reason; no other exclusion
note: One host, loopback, 2 vCPU, no other load control. Results characterise this host only.
